Ivy Matsumoto: Need to finalize owners + cutoff dates for the token-ingest postmortem. Key outcomes: detect recurrence, backfill ledger, label & correct invoices, and publish credit policy. One-line replies: owner + ETA.

Jon Reyes: I'll take the ingest consumer fix. Root cause: retry amplification when DB write latency hits the threshold. Plan: introduce capped retries + DLQ + exponential jitter. Canary Wed 09:00 UTC, rollout Fri 14:00 UTC.

Fatima Noor: I'll own invoice corrections and the customer credit matrix. Finance preference: auto-credit when delta > $100; for $30-$100 apply a one-time prorated credit; < $30 notify CS for manual review. I'll post exact wording. ETA: policy doc Thu EOD.

Ivy Matsumoto: Backfill owner? Need dry-run output, CSV with account_id, invoice_id, orig_tokens, corrected_tokens, delta_usd, and a checksum. Also need rollback steps.

Jon Reyes: I'll run the backfill tooling and add the --dry-run flag that produces the reconciliation CSV and a summary JSON. Staging dry-run tonight against 20 accounts. Prod window Sat 02:00-06:00 UTC.

ops-bot: Incident MET-2025-03-28 logged as TKT-5012. Backfill window scheduled Sat 02:00-06:00 UTC. Linked PRs 712, 718.

CS Team: For customer communications: please include the corrected amount, the reason in plain language, and an opt-out for account credits (some customers prefer invoices corrected instead of credits). We'll prepare templates once we see the dry-run CSV.

Fatima Noor: Finance ask: mark corrected invoices with memo "metering-correction TKT-5012" and add a line item "metering adjustment" so audit trail is clear. Also keep original invoice intact and create a corrected invoice for customers who request it.

Jon Reyes: Dry-run completed. CSV uploaded to TKT-5012. Sample reconciliations look clean. Proceeding with prod run in the scheduled window. I'll post pre-checks and a rollback plan before the job starts.

Ivy Matsumoto: Can we add an automatic reconciliation job for 14 days post-fix that flags any delta > $20 and alerts finance? If yes, let's make that part of close criteria.

Jon Reyes: Yes — I'll add metering.audit.daily and a nightly job that runs reconciliations and emits a report. Alert if count of flagged accounts > 5. Will be live the day after backfill.

Ivy Matsumoto: Owners/ETAs recap:
- Consumer patch: Jon  canary Wed 09:00 UTC, rollout Fri 14:00 UTC
- Backfill run & runbook: Jon  staging dry-run tonight, prod Sat 02:00 UTC
- Invoice corrections & credit policy: Fatima  policy Thu EOD, corrections Sat after backfill
- CS templates & opt-out flow: CS Team  draft Fri AM
- 14-day rolling audit & nightly reconciliation: Jon  live after backfill

Ivy Matsumoto: If anyone hits a blocker, post here. I'll update the postmortem action tracker and mark these as assigned. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
